scientific_target: survey-recorded summer-generation patch colonisation: surveyed non-detection at t followed by surveyed detection at t+1
response_independent_node_definition: dry unfertilized grassland patch containing at least one larval host plant, separated from adjacent patches by >=50 m of divergent vegetation
declared_node_universe: all 50 habitat-defined monitored patches, not the response-conditioned 40 patches occupied at least once used in some original analyses

allowed_before_outcome_authorization: Site_data.csv only after metadata verifies it is physically separate from Monitoring_data.csv
published methods and aggregate colonisation/extinction summaries

prospective_split_candidate.note: Frozen before response access; exact usable rows remain subject to published survey-availability semantics and the once-only exact count gate.

prospective_estimability.published_aggregate: mean 2.64 colonisation events per year over 13 years; blockwise exact counts not inspected
prospective_estimability.execution_policy: continue response-blind only; exact count gate required before any fit or heldout score

source_process_boundary: Primary interpretation will be conditional on realised sources inside the declared monitored patch network unless stronger closure is established response-blind. External recruitment is not silently claimed absent.
gate0_pass_requires: stable public Dryad version and separate Monitoring_data.csv / Site_data.csv identities
Site_data.csv contains a complete response-independent patch registry with usable geometry for the declared 50-patch universe
Site_data.csv contains no butterfly response columns
survey design supports explicit unavailable/missing patch-years rather than treating unsurveyed years as zero
no_rescue: do not subset to patches occupied at least once
do not open Monitoring_data.csv to determine candidate eligibility
do not redefine split after outcome access
do not lower frozen exact count minima
do not add candidate-specific connectivity operators
